description: Pins the 'no config file found' refusal (exit 3, NEEDS_CONFIG) across all 10 command paths named in Scout finding 2bc51a#2: projects, inspect, directives show, workers, start, stop, add, check, down, up, new. Each passes --config against a path this sandbox never creates, since the harness always materializes home/config.toml (even empty) and omitting home.config_toml therefore cannot reach this branch — the same reason mv-cli's own a_missing_config_file_needs_config_not_a_bare_error unit test (review_policy.rs) uses a definitely-absent path rather than relying on no file existing at the default location. Neither message form is unified here, only pinned as-is: projects/inspect/directives/workers raise Failure::Config, rendered 'config error: {msg}' on stderr with no trailing doctor-check line; start/stop/add/check/down/up/new print their own two-line 'config error: ...\nRun `multiverse doctor`...' form to stdout via Failure::Reported. No step's transcript allows any Herdr call, confirming the refusal fires before any fleet probe.
